messages.text:
Future Perfect tense chala easy bro! Action oka specific time kalla complete aipotundi ani cheppadaniki idi vadutam.

**Formula:** 
Subject + will have + past participle ($V_3$ verb)

**Examples:**
- By December, **I will have secured** my internship. (Idi manaki chala important goal!)
- By tomorrow evening, **she will have completed** her project.

Interviewer-style test kosam oka question: **"By next year, I ___ (learn) advanced Python."** Blank lo correct tense endi?
